maps: Historical panel split by physical terrain; all original pair hold/outside maps are excluded from the sequence corpus. Top5 panel uses its frozen split, first 8 train, 2 val, 2 held per teacher sorted by SHA-256; no resampling. No held map sets regularization, threshold or epoch.
inputs: Only the final bundle's public prefix features. Labels use original Master3s2 commands in archives and top-five commands in ladder games. A sample requires legal replay action and identical preceding unit commands under the unmodified parent decoder. Select planter and collector decisions at 64,72,...,192, with complete 24-step windows. No worker is selected using its future.
target: Within distance two of observed next destination, own minus opponent ground rent (excluding cargo tax) plus signed tree investment, versus same-region average over prior eight steps; add one quarter of both-side own-delivery differential per living own worker. Stage/role/source stratified training-only scaling, 1+0.8*tanh advantage weighting (strictly positive), per root-role weight normalized over eligible slots. H=4 and H=24 arms use identical rows and optimizer. Archived same-root independently responding original pairs on train terrains add a supervised two-action ranking for the same horizon when their executed joint prefix agrees with the parent up to the focal worker. These branches each have only one sampled response.
updates: Student U and V including biases, 12 fixed epochs, Adam step .002 for both arms; KL to parent mixture. Quantize each candidate via standard pack.
held_check: On frozen historical and ladder holdout terrain maps compare H24-weighted NLL at normal public entry across independently running final packs. Require strictly lower map-average held loss than both parent and H4 plus at least four changed focal deployment actions on two terrains, with held original and elite source losses separately reported. Fail closes this candidate for fresh complete games. Archived held pair actual full joint matches reported separately; unsupported alternatives unscored. No source arm gets wins credited for different actions.
